title: The Alchemist Observatory
one_sentence: A forgotten observatory built inside the ribcage of a dead celestial being.
source_prompt: A forgotten alchemist observatory inside the ribcage of a dead god.

intent.setting: An abandoned observatory chamber held within a vast ribcage structure.
intent.emotional_goal: The first view should feel solemn, old, and quietly impossible.
intent.primary_interaction: Inspect the warm central lens and decide whether to reveal the hidden star map.
intent.spatial_logic: A central astrolabe table anchors a circular chamber, with ribs forming arches around it.

style.lighting: Cold moonlight enters through cracked ribs while warm candles reveal brass details.

required_elements.description: Rib bones forming the chamber architecture.
A brass astrolabe table with a black glass lens.
A strong cold moonbeam crossing the central table.
A sealed archive door hinted at beyond the main chamber.

camera_intents.purpose: First impression of the chamber and central table.
Inspect the black glass lens and candle-lit brass.

curiosity_goals: Why is the central lens warm?
What lies behind the sealed archive door?
Who built an observatory inside this ribcage?
authoring_notes: Phase 1 contract example. The scene graph is the source of truth until scene .lth syntax lands.
